blocks.text: Joel Embiid sparked the NBA-best Philadelphia 76ers to a fifth consecutive victory on Saturday, beating Milwaukee 132-129 despite Tyler Herro’s 50 points for the Bucks. Embiid delivered 26 points, a season-high 17 rebounds and nine assists for the host Sixers as they dropped the NBA-worst Bucks to 1-16 and stretched Milwaukee’s losing skid to 13 games. Herro netted a career-high 50 points and added 11 rebounds and seven assists, but he missed a chance to send the game into overtime.
